final: SELECT DISTINCT s.first_name, s.middle_name, s.last_name FROM Students s JOIN Student_Enrolment se ON s.student_id = se.student_id JOIN Degree_Programs dp ON se.degree_program_id = dp.degree_program_id WHERE dp.degree_summary_name = 'Bachelor' ORDER BY s.first_name, s.middle_name, s.last_name
